title: Rotate Linked List Left and Right

content.problemStatement: Rotate a singly linked list by k positions either left or right.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Example demonstrating Rotate list by k positions either Left ('L') or Right ('R').
Example demonstrating Rotate list by k positions either Left ('L') or Right ('R').

solution.approach: Rotate list by k positions either Left ('L') or Right ('R').

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if toks:
        n = int(toks[0])
        k = int(toks[1]) % n
        direction = toks[2].upper()
        arr = toks[3:3+n]
        if direction == "R": rot = arr[-k:] + arr[:-k] if k > 0 else arr
        else: rot = arr[k:] + arr[:k] if k > 0 else arr
        print(" ".join(rot))
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

editorial.overview: Modulo k by N. If Right: arr[-k:] + arr[:-k]. If Left: arr[k:] + arr[:k]. Print space-separated.
